description: This file is a shell script used for capturing, managing, and viewing logs related to the uvicorn server in the skill_story_backend project. It provides commands for starting, stopping, displaying, and filtering logs of the backend uvicorn process, specifically tailored for this particular project's setup.

methods.name: find_uvicorn_pid_by_port
methods.description: Finds the PID of the uvicorn process listening on a specified port using lsof or grep as fallback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the log capturing process for the uvicorn server running on a specified port, creating a PID file.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the log capturing process by killing the process whose PID is stored in the PID file.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the latest logs from the log file, defaulting to the last 300 lines.

methods.name: since
methods.description: Outputs logs added after a specific Unix epoch timestamp.
